body.purpose: Desktop preview prose; mobile uses body-mobile.

source.purpose: Source lines; preview code uses 1.6 line-height.

site-display.purpose: The landing h1 only (hero row); system sans, balanced.

site-chrome.purpose: Mono feature label, chips, tabs, bands, terminals, pane code.

site-status.purpose: Mono kbd, pane status bars, install Copy action.

site-label.purpose: Uppercase mono chrome names (pane heads, note titles); never a headline eyebrow.

site-docs-nav.purpose: Vocs sidebar items; the text-only outline uses 0.75rem on 22px rows.

shadows.name: control
shadows.purpose: Outlined primitives and diagram controls; theme overrides inherit.

motion.name: theme-menu
motion.purpose: Theme-menu state transitions; reduced motion applies.

motion.name: site-stage-fade
motion.purpose: Landing stage pane swap; reduced motion swaps without the fade.

motion.name: site-button
motion.purpose: Landing button background and border color.

components.description: Shared Button primary variant; default 40px size.

narrative.overview:
zero follows familiar editor conventions: a compact explorer, document tabs, a readable preview, and a quiet status footer. Square panes meet on 1px hairlines; slate surfaces, flat rows, and restrained controls keep local files central.

Workspace identity sits above the explorer. App identity, content search, process state, and theme selection sit in the footer. There is no top app header; the logo sits in the footer and on Welcome. Mobile keeps the document visible and opens files in a drawer.
keyCharacteristics: Square corners and panes on hairlines; slate Zero surfaces.
Left-aligned proportional prose and monospace code.
Shared semantic roles across named editor themes.
Site: a framed 75rem column on 1px blue-tinted rails over a diagonal hatch.
Site: one mild tint per feature, on its row's top edge and its pane's framing.
Site: HTML-built app panes at app density, captioned "synthetic demo"; no screenshots, no SVG animation.
Site: square corners, 1px borders, mono chrome labels, system type.

rules.name: The Functional Accent Rule
rules.body: Use accent for state and interaction; keep routine prose headings and large surfaces neutral.

rules.name: The Tint Follows the Feature Rule
rules.body: A feature's tint marks it everywhere at once: its row's top edge, its copy's terminal, and its pane's framing (coral remote terminal, green lean ledger). Tints are borders and edges, never fills or text.

rules.name: The Coral Reserve Rule
rules.body: Coral belongs to the logo mark and to remote (plus docs warnings and dangers). No other feature takes it.

rules.name: The Four-Sided Border Rule
rules.body: In the docs chrome a tinted element is framed on all four sides by a 1px border: code blocks take `tint-blue` on `surface`; callouts take their kind's tint with its wash (note and info blue, tip and success green, warning and danger coral). No side stripes on callouts, code, or content.

dos: Do reuse semantic CSS tokens and shared primitives across every theme.
Do retain 15px desktop / 16px mobile prose, 75ch measure, and left alignment.
Do keep file/path search separate from content search.
Do preserve keyboard focus, accessible labels, modal behavior, and reduced motion.
Do keep fonts, icons, and runtime assets local to the embedded Go distribution.
Do review shadcn-generated code against this system and strict TypeScript: no `any`, non-null assertions, or type assertions.
Do scope landing styles under `.landing` with `--l-*` tokens, and docs styles in `_root.css` with `--sz-*` tokens over Vocs' `data-v-*` hooks.
Do write every site color as `light-dark(light, dark)` so both Vocs themes follow its toggle.
Do give each feature one tint and repeat it on its row's top edge, its terminal, and its pane framing.
Do build demo panes in HTML and CSS from the slate tokens at app density, captioned "synthetic demo"; state facts, not benchmarks.
Do frame docs code and callouts with a full 1px tinted border.
Do keep landing type on the system sans and mono stacks.
Do grow touch controls to 44px under 900px.
donts: Don't add a top app header or logo; keep workspace identity above the explorer and app identity in the footer.
Don't restore the mobile split; use the files drawer with 40px rows and 44px toolbar/footer.
Don't center preview prose or substitute generic heading/body tokens for the preview scale.
Don't introduce decorative gradients, pill containers, heavy shadows, or cards around document sections.
Don't rely on color alone for selection, focus, errors, or status.
Don't require a CDN, frontend sidecar, or system JavaScript runtime in production; build and embed assets, never edit `apps/zero/internal/web/dist/` directly.
Don't round a corner on the site; `_root.css` keeps every Vocs radius at 0.
Don't give docs callouts, code blocks, or content a side stripe; the tint goes on all four sides.
Don't use coral beyond the logo mark, remote, and docs warnings.
Don't fill surfaces or set text in a tint; tints are borders and edges.
Don't replace panes with screenshots or SVG animation, or put RAM figures in them.
Don't hijack scroll, bind global keys, or present the landing as a walkthrough or a numbered sequence; rows are plain sections (decision 0106).
Don't set the uppercase label style above a headline as an eyebrow; it names chrome. A feature row's label is the lowercase mono feature name.
Don't let docs `pre` or inline `code` rules reach the landing; `_root.css` excludes `.landing`.
